working_on.feature: Automated Android Release CI/CD & Secure Secret Management
working_on.task: Fixed local java.home path in gradle.properties and baseline profile wildcard syntax. Successfully built, signed, and published release APK on GitHub Actions.
working_on.notes: Release v1.0 successfully published on GitHub Actions with signed APK: ev-plus-v1.0.apk.

recent_changes.description: Fixed runner secret condition syntax and release tag parsing, verified GitHub Actions run 34195491881 in_progress.

Added GitHub Actions automated release pipeline: slugify app name, auto-increment minor release version, decode Base64 keystore & google-services.json, build assembleRelease, rename APK and publish GitHub Release.
Protected google-services.json and *.jks via .gitignore, provided app/google-services.json.example template, and generated Base64 secret strings.

errors_encountered.error: GitHub Actions validation failure: Unrecognized named-value 'secrets' in step if condition
errors_encountered.solution: Refactored secret check inside bash script using env vars [ -n "$SECRET" ]

decisions_made.decision: Use Base64 encoded GitHub Actions Secrets for google-services.json and keystore.jks
decisions_made.reason: Prevents secret leakage in public/private repositories while maintaining automated CI/CD builds

decisions_made.decision: Use softprops/action-gh-release@v2 with auto minor tag increment
decisions_made.reason: Automates GitHub Releases with zero manual versioning intervention on every push to main
